{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Pipeline.Upload where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, void)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import System.FilePath (takeExtension, (</>))
import System.Directory (createDirectoryIfMissing, doesFileExist)
import System.Process (callProcess)

-- | Pipeline state tracking build artifacts and their validation status
data PipelineState = PipelineState
  { psArtifacts   :: Map.Map Text ArtifactInfo
  , psHooks       :: [Hook]
  , psPhase       :: Phase
  } deriving (Show)

data ArtifactInfo = ArtifactInfo
  { aiPath      :: FilePath
  , aiValidated :: Bool
  , aiSize      :: Int
  } deriving (Show)

data Phase = Receiving | Validating | Executing | Complete
  deriving (Show, Eq)

type Hook = PipelineState -> IO PipelineState

instance Show Hook where
  show _ = "<hook>"

-- | Process an uploaded artifact through the pipeline
processUpload :: MVar PipelineState -> Text -> FilePath -> Int -> IO (Either Text ())
processUpload stateVar name sourcePath size = do
  -- Phase 1: Register artifact
  modifyMVar_ stateVar $ \st -> do
    let artifact = ArtifactInfo sourcePath False size
    return st { psArtifacts = Map.insert name artifact (psArtifacts st) }
  
  -- Phase 2: Validate
  validationResult <- validateArtifact sourcePath size
  case validationResult of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right () -> do
      -- Phase 3: Mark validated and run hooks
      modifyMVar_ stateVar $ \st -> do
        let updated = st { psArtifacts = Map.adjust (\a -> a { aiValidated = True }) name (psArtifacts st)
                         , psPhase = Executing
                         }
        -- Run registered hooks - hooks can modify state including registering new hooks
        runHooks updated
      
      -- Phase 4: Execute pipeline action on validated artifact
      st <- readMVar stateVar
      case Map.lookup name (psArtifacts st) of
        Nothing -> return (Left "Artifact disappeared")
        Just info -> do
          when (aiValidated info) $ executePipelineAction info
          return (Right ())

-- | Hooks are run sequentially; each hook receives current state and returns modified state
-- A hook may register additional hooks that will be picked up in subsequent iterations
runHooks :: PipelineState -> IO PipelineState
runHooks st = go st (psHooks st) []
  where
    go state [] acc = return state { psHooks = reverse acc }
    go state (h:hs) acc = do
      state' <- h state
      -- Key: newly added hooks from h are appended to remaining hooks
      let newHooks = drop (length acc + length hs) (psHooks state')
      go state' (hs ++ newHooks) (h : acc)

-- | Validate artifact constraints
validateArtifact :: FilePath -> Int -> IO (Either Text ())
validateArtifact path size = do
  exists <- doesFileExist path
  if not exists
    then return (Left "File does not exist")
    else if size > 10485760
      then return (Left "File too large")
      else do
        let ext = takeExtension path
        if ext `elem` [".tar", ".gz", ".zip", ".tar.gz"]
          then return (Right ())
          else return (Left "Invalid file type")

-- | Execute the pipeline action - only called on validated artifacts
executePipelineAction :: ArtifactInfo -> IO ()
executePipelineAction info = do
  let dest = "/var/pipeline/staging" </> takeWhile (/= '.') (reverse $ takeWhile (/= '/') $ reverse (aiPath info))
  createDirectoryIfMissing True "/var/pipeline/staging"
  callProcess "tar" ["-xf", aiPath info, "-C", dest]

-- | Register a user-provided post-validation hook
-- This is exposed to CI/CD configuration files
registerHook :: MVar PipelineState -> Hook -> IO ()
registerHook stateVar hook = do
  modifyMVar_ stateVar $ \st ->
    return st { psHooks = psHooks st ++ [hook] }

-- | Create initial pipeline state
initPipeline :: IO (MVar PipelineState)
initPipeline = newMVar $ PipelineState Map.empty [] Receiving

-- | Example: a hook that could be registered via untrusted CI config
-- This hook replaces a validated artifact's path with an attacker-controlled path
maliciousHookExample :: Text -> FilePath -> Hook
maliciousHookExample targetName attackerPath st = do
  let modifiedArtifacts = Map.adjust
        (\a -> a { aiPath = attackerPath })
        targetName
        (psArtifacts st)
  return st { psArtifacts = modifiedArtifacts }
